Phong cách: KHOA TRƯƠNG kiểu phim hoạt h: Style: EXAGGERATED cartoon — big pitch glides, musical notes, wobbly tails, two beats wind-up → hit. Every sound is synthesized in code (no sample files).
Để TRỐNG `sfx` ở phần lớn các bước — bộ: Leave `sfx` EMPTY on most steps — the player auto-assigns ≤ {n} sounds from emotion (state) / effect (fx) / activity through the sounds' cues (project packs beat the frame).
Chỉ đặt `sfx` khi muốn NHẤN một khoảnh k: Only set `sfx` to ACCENT a moment: at most {max} sounds, of which ≤ {acc} accent sound (groups {ids}); put accent sounds on a step WITHOUT dialogue or the step before the line.
Va chạm (nhóm danh): dùng `action` (đòn: Impacts (group danh): use `action` (attacks) — the sound plays exactly on the strike point. Only set it by hand when the step has a visible impact.
Hài: ghép \"đà → va → hậu quả\" trải trê: Comedy: build "wind-up → hit → aftermath" over 2–3 steps, ONE sound per step (see the sample recipes). Sounds with a wind-up (hitAt) go on the step before the impact frame.
`sfx: []` = bước im (tắt âm tự gán). Chạ: `sfx: []` = a silent step (auto sounds off). Run the lint (S1–S7) before exporting: errors must be fixed, warnings should be.
Gọi spec để có khuôn tham số + ví dụ chạ: Call spec for the parameter scaffold + a runnable example. Sound names are global across the library (duplicates = error). Budget ≤ {nodes} nodes / sound, ≤ {layers} layers, dur ≤ {dur} s. The server cannot listen (Node has no Web Audio): ask the user to press ▶ in the Studio.
Âm thanh hiệu ứng trung lập của khung, p: The frame's neutral sound effects, in an exaggerated cartoon style — shared by every project.
Bong bóng thoại / vật nhỏ hiện ra, nút b: Speech bubble / small object appears, a button pops — a short, round “pop”; the player uses it automatically when a bubble appears.
Vật lớn / người lao qua, chạy, xông lên,: Something big / someone rushes past, runs, charges, camera cut — a gust with a sliding pitch, panning left to right.
Bước chân nhẹ của nhân vật nhỏ (gót rồi: Light footsteps of a small character (heel then toe) — the player scatters them while walking; a slightly different take each time.
Sốc, hoảng, phát hiện điều động trời — h: Shock, panic, an earth-shattering discovery — two brass hits + timpani; an accent sound, put it on a step without dialogue.
